p.n: Enmity Turns into Friendship in Times of Need

body.p:

p.n: The Cat Is the Rat's Worst Enemy

body.p:
You are an enemy unto me and I unto you. How can
friendship work between us,

p.n: The Rat's Need for Friendship Has Gone
The Cat Desires the Rat for Food

body.p: I know that you have no

p.n: The Rat's Need for Friendship Has Gone

body.p:
need except that of eating me You and I were compelled,
by a need, to enter an agreement, and the matter which made you need me and which obliged me
to you has passed. I fear, then, that in its passing is the return of the enmity between you and me.

p.n: The Weak Must Avoid the Strong

body.p:
There is no good in the weak becoming close with the powerful enemy and no good in the humble approaching the grand.’
“
And so the rat stood firm in his stance, remaining wary of the cat.”
This has been the parable of the rat who became friend to the cat.
